gist: Back of cover/blank leaf; ЦГИАЛ archive stamp ф. 497 оп. 17(?) ед. хр. 808 at foot and faint pencil numbers at top. No content.

Opening statement of the copy book: on 10 Oct 1892 'ст. секр.(?) Петров...(?)' authorised acquisition (пріобрѣтеніе) of 1469 copies of the 1st выпуск. In Moscow were 125+144+155 = 424 copies of the 1st issue, of which 114 sold 'въ пользу издателей' and 9 given free by their order = 123. Crown (казенныхъ) copies: Moscow 301, SPb 1168 = 1469 (margin: 301-144=157). Last line begins the 1 Dec 1893 Moscow account (continued p.3). [1-й выпуск presumably = the 1890-91 Yearbook — inference, not stated.]
why: Directorate's purchase of 1469 copies of the first Yearbook issue from its publishers (издатели), with Moscow/SPb split and sales/free copies: print-run and early publishing arrangement.

gist: Continuation of p.2 (verso of л.1): of the 301 Moscow copies by 1 Dec 1893 sold 223, remained in Moscow 78 = 301 ('I отчетъ'). Money for the 223 copies ('по разнымъ цѣнамъ') sent by the Moscow Контора to the SPb Контора: 489 р. 60 к. (an earlier sum struck out).
why: Sales and revenue figures for issue 1 in Moscow; sold at varying prices.

gist: Reconciliation worksheet for the 1469 copies bought: delivered by the Типографія to the Ц. Б. (Central Library) 1260 (157+1103?); given free to ...(? 'прослужившимъ'?) persons on the 2nd issue(?) 8; a struck line 'взято въ розницу(?)...' 49/50; remained in the Типографія 152; = 1469. Below, much-corrected tallies by place: Ц. Б. 1108+52 = 1160, Тип. 152, Москва 157+144 = 301; total 1312 (Ц.Б.+Тип.) + 301.
why: Stock distribution of the purchased print run between printing house, Central Library and Moscow; several words of the free-copy line uncertain.

gist: Ledger page headed 'I выпускъ (СПб.)': Поступило 1168 экз. Nothing else entered.
why: Only the SPb receipt total for issue I (1168 copies); stock figure, no sales entered.

gist: 'I выпускъ (Москва)': received by 1 Dec 1893 301 copies. Columns sold/issued copies, sum, issued free, total issued, on hand. To 1 Dec 1893 (отчетъ I): 223 sold, 489 р. 60 к., 0 free, 223, on hand 78. To 1 June 1895 (отч. II): 40 sold, 103 р. 50 к., 1 free, 41, on hand 37. Totals 263 / 593 р. 10 к. / 1 / 264 / 37.
why: Moscow sales and revenue of issue I through June 1895.

gist: '2-й выпускъ (СПб.)': 'Поступило экземпляровъ ......' with no figure entered; rest blank.
why: Empty ledger heading for issue 2 in SPb.

date: къ 1 декабря 1893 г.; къ 1 іюня 1895 г.
gist: '2-й выпускъ (Москва)': received by 1 Dec 1893 564 copies (555+9). To 1 Dec 1893 (отчетъ I): 269 sold for 557 р. 40 к.(? corrected), 15 free (pencil 16?), total 284, on hand 280. To 1 June 1895 (отч. II): 106 sold for 321 р. 90 к., 7 free, 113, on hand 167. Totals 375 / 879 р. 30 к. / 22 / 397 / 167.
why: Moscow stock, sales and revenue for issue 2.

gist: '3-й выпускъ (СПб.)' heading over ruled columns; no entries.
'3-й выпускъ (Москва)': received by 1 June 1895 400 copies. To 1 June 1895 (отчетъ II): 328 sold for 868 р., 10 free, 338 issued, 62 on hand.
why: Moscow allocation (400), sales and revenue for issue 3.

gist: '4-й вып. (СПб.)' heading over ruled columns; no entries.

'4-й выпускъ (Москва)': received by 1 June 1895 400 copies. To 1 June 1895 (отчетъ II): 265 sold for 902 р. 30 к., 23 free, 288 issued, on hand (95) in pencil. Note: 'Отправл. въ Губ. Тип. — 17 экз.' (= Губернская типографія, Moscow; cf. Д. 1167 p.8)
why: Moscow allocation, sales and revenue for issue 4.

gist: 'Отправлено Москвой денегъ' by issue I-V: to 1 Dec 1893 I 489-60, II 557-40 = 1047 р.; to 1 June 1895 I 103-50, II 321-90, III 868-, IV 902-30, V none = 2195 р. 70 к. Grand total 3242 р. 70 к. (I 593-10, II 879-30, III 868, IV 902-30).
why: Summary of Moscow sale revenue remitted for Yearbook issues I-IV, 1893-1895.
